title: CIA jump room to Mars that Obama used

tellings.quote: The story is the CIA story is they go up to the fifth floor and then on the elevator and then it goes across and then they they they jump to Mars and Obama's been there

plain: The story goes that the CIA has a "jump room": people go up to the fifth floor of a building, ride an elevator that then moves sideways, and from there they "jump to Mars", and Barack Obama is said to have been there. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as a story he credits to Andrew Basiago, a man who says he took part in secret government teleportation programs. If true, it would mean the US has had secret travel to Mars.
